title: CRISPR Editing of LSD Genes in H9-AAVS1-TRE3G-NGN2-TMEM192-3xHA Cells
author: Harper JW

steps.title: Assemble Cas9‑sgRNA RNP
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL buffer R to a sterile 1.5 mL tube, add 6 µg purified Cas9 or Cpf1 protein (2 mg/mL), add 1.2 µg sgRNA, pipet up and down to mix, and incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes to allow complex formation; this mixture is sufficient for two 24‑well transfections. Buffer R is from the Neon Transfection Kit (Invitrogen, MPK1096B).

steps.title: Prepare and count cells
steps.instruction: While the RNP forms, detach H9‑AAVS1‑TRE3G‑NGN2‑TMEM192‑3xHA cells with Accutase, neutralize Accutase with 5× volume E8 medium containing Rock inhibitor, count cells and collect 2 × 10⁵ cells per transfection, spin down, let the pellet settle, remove excess supernatant with a P200 pipet if needed, and resuspend cells in buffer R to a concentration of 2 × 10⁵ cells per 5 µL (4 × 10⁷ cells/mL), accounting for any residual media volume.

steps.title: Set up Matrigel‑coated 24‑well plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a Matrigel‑coated 24‑well plate; add 0.5–1 mL E8 medium supplemented with Rock inhibitor at 1:1000 to each well to be used, then add Human Serum Albumin at 1:2500. Allocate one well per transfection; typically perform 2–3 transfections per gRNA‑Cas9 complex.

steps.title: Ready Neon electroporation system
steps.instruction: Wipe the Neon pipet station with ethanol and place it inside the hood. Add 3 mL electrolytic buffer (buffer E) to the Neon tube, insert the tube into the station until a click is felt, confirming secure seating. Set the electroporation program to 13 (program 9 is an alternative).

steps.title: Mix cells with RNP and electroporate
steps.instruction: When cells and RNP are ready, combine 10–11 µL of the cell suspension with the Cas9/Cpf1‑sgRNA R buffer mixture so that the final volume is 21–22 µL. Load 10 µL of this mixture into a NEON tip, insert the tip slowly to avoid air bubbles, and electroporate using program 13. If an air bubble appears, expel the contents and re‑pipet. Avoid sparking; if sparking occurs, efficiency will be reduced.

steps.title: Transfer cells to plate and incubate
steps.instruction: Immediately after electroporation, dispense the entire mixture into the designated well of the prepared 24‑well plate (do not pipet up/down with the Neon tip). Disperse cells evenly and place the plate in a low‑oxygen incubator for 2 days to maintain viability.

steps.title: Sort cells into 96‑well plates
steps.instruction: After 2 days, sort cells into individual wells of a 96‑well plate containing E8 medium plus 10 % Clone R2 (STEMCELL Technologies). Keep plates in the low‑oxygen incubator for 3–4 days until colonies are visible, then transfer to a regular incubator. Change to standard E8 medium every other day.

steps.title: Post‑sorting split and expand
steps.instruction: 10–14 days post‑sorting, split each clone into two sets: one for sequencing and one for expansion. During splitting, maintain 10 µM Rock inhibitor and 12.5 µg/mL human serum albumin (HSA); consolidate cells if necessary.

steps.title: Screen clones by PCR and MS
steps.instruction: Perform PCR‑based sequencing of the targeted allele using primers listed in the Materials section, then validate selected clones by mass spectrometry.
